achieved.instructions: The work reported in `roundDigest` satisfies the whole `objective`, not merely a part of it

evidence.instructions: `roundDigest` contains concrete evidence that `objective` is achieved — completed artifacts, passing checks, or verified results — not only a claim that it is done

progress.instructions: How much of `objective` did the work in `roundDigest` move toward completion

action.instructions: Given `objective`, `round`, and `roundDigest`, the single best next action for the agent is

criteria.continue: The round made progress; keep working in the next round as planned
criteria.verify-complete: The objective appears achieved; the agent should verify and mark the goal complete now instead of spending another round
criteria.report-blocked: A concrete obstacle persists across rounds; the agent should report the goal blocked with that condition or take a materially different approach

sameObstacle.instructions: The obstacle described in `roundDigest.finalMessage` is materially the same obstacle described in `previousFinals`
